description: The Trump administration has announced more than $6 billion in science programmes, including a $215 million competition to advance fault-tolerant quantum computing. The US Department of Energy has outlined eight research areas and a staged funding structure, with awards tied to technical milestones and future congressional appropriations. The initiative comes amid renewed concerns that advances in quantum computing could threaten encryption standards used by cryptocurrencies.
title: Trump Announces $215 Million Quantum Computing Push as Crypto Security Concerns Rise

description: Motorola showcased the second model in the brand's Signature series at the India Mobile Congress (IMC) 2026 on Friday. The handset, known as the Motorola Signature 27, was unveiled in global markets last month and is set to arrive in India. Over the years, the brand has settled on a familiar smartphone design language. Phones across price segments have shared similar-looking rear panels and camera modules. Only changes in materials and colours have done much to distinguish one from another.
title: Motorola Signature 27 First Look

description: Infinix GT 50 Pro is all set to launch in India this month, and the brand has now announced its launch date. It is expected to arrive as the latest addition to its gaming-focused GT lineup, succeeding the Infinix GT 30 Pro that debuted in the country in June last year. The upcoming handset will feature a Cyber Mecha-inspired exterior and two colour options. Similar to the global model, Infinix has equipped it with a liquid cooling system that is partly visible through the rear panel.
title: Infinix GT 50 Pro India Launch Date Announced; Colour Options, HydroFlow Liquid Cooling System Teased

description: Dell launched two new laptops in India on Friday as part of its Pro Rugged series, namely Dell Pro Rugged 13 Extreme and Dell Pro Rugged 14. The two laptops are currently on sale in the country via the company website. The Dell Pro Rugged 13 Extreme sports a rugged build with an IP66 rating for dust and water resistance, along with HazLoc C1D2 and MIL-STD-810/MIL-STD-461G certifications. On the other hand, the Dell Pro Rugged 14 has a semi-rugged build, which is claimed to endure a 3-foot drop and operate in -20 degrees Fahrenheit to 145 degrees Fahrenheit. It ships with an IP53 rating for dust and splash resistance, too.
title: Dell Pro Rugged 13 Extreme, Pro Rugged 14 Launched in India With Up to Intel Core Ultra 7 Processor: Price, Specifications

description: Thailand’s Securities and Exchange Commission has introduced 11 regulations for cryptocurrency exchange-traded funds, effective October 16. The initial framework permits funds tracking Bitcoin and Ether, with listings restricted to the Stock Exchange of Thailand. Fund managers must meet investment, custody, and investor protection requirements, while digital assets must be held with licensed Thai custodians. The effective date does not guarantee that ETFs will begin trading immediately.
title: Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs to Become Available in Thailand From October 16

description: Apple is scheduled to host the 'Welcome Home' launch event on October 13, Apple’s Senior Vice President of Worldwide Marketing, Greg Joswiak, announced on Thursday. The ‘Welcome Home’ event will take place in Tribeca, New York, and will commence at 9 am ET (6:30 pm IST). During the ‘Welcome Home’ event, the company is expected to launch its first smart home hub, along with the HomePod Mini (2026) and the Apple TV 4K (2026). According to a Bloomberg report, Apple will host the second event on October 27. The event will reportedly witness the launch of Apple’s first MacBook model with a touchscreen, the new MacBook Pro with the M6 chipset, the next-generation iMac with the M6 chip upgrade, and the new iPad Mini model.
title: Apple ‘Welcome Home’ Event Set for Next Week With First Smart Home Hub and More Expected; Could Host Another Event in Late October

description: Samsung Galaxy S27 series will be launched at a significantly higher price than its predecessor, the leaked pricing details suggest.
